title: What Would Jiminy Cricket Do? Towards Agents That Behave Morally

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating reinforcement learning agents in the Jiminy Cricket suite of 25 text-based adventure games using dense, manually annotated morality labels to measure the frequency and severity of immoral actions (e.g., theft, murder) that are taken because they are implicitly incentivized or unpunished by the environment's reward function.
